standard_prerequisites.name: Algebraicity of 2-fibre products of algebraic stacks
standard_prerequisites.use: The 2-fibre product of the presentations is an algebraic stack, hence equivalent to S_F.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base-change property transfer
standard_prerequisites.use: S_F -> (Sch/W) is surjective smooth as a base change of y.

standard_prerequisites.name: Composition property transfer
standard_prerequisites.use: S_F -> X is surjective smooth; also the final etale composition.

core_obligations: Choose a surjective smooth presentation z: (Sch/W) -> X (exists by definition of an algebraic stack).
The 2-fibre product (Sch/W) x_{f o z, Y, y} (Sch/V) is an algebraic stack; choose the equivalence j: S_F -> it with F an algebraic space.
S_F -> (Sch/W) is surjective smooth as a base change of y; hence S_F -> X is surjective smooth by composition.
Choose U -> F surjective etale from a scheme and compose to obtain the required 2-commutative diagram with x surjective smooth.
proof_roadmap: Presentation choice; fibre-product algebraicity; two property transfers; etale chart composition.
difficulty_reason: A presentation-lifting construction; the fibre-product algebraicity identification plus the transfers are the substance.
